\title{Detecting Order-Dependent Flaky Tests in Java Projects}
\author{\IEEEauthorblockN{Anonymous Author(s)}\IEEEauthorblockA{Anonymous Institution}}

\begin{abstract}
Flaky tests pass and fail on the same code. The detector of this paper reruns each test in shuffled orders and
labels 51 of 533 tests as flaky.
\end{abstract}
\begin{IEEEkeywords}
flaky tests, test order dependence, regression testing
